    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_presilting_class_of_frobenius_square {k F R : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k] [Field F] [Finite F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] {X Y : ScalarCategory k F (FGModuleCat R)} (hX : Module.Projective R ↑X.obj) (hY : Module.Projective R ↑Y.obj) (p : X ⟶ Y) (hp : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear F p p)) (a : X ≅ X) (b : Y ≅ Y) (h : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom p = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((ScalarCategory.changeScalars ↑(FiniteField.frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic k F)).map p) b.hom) :
    ∃ (P : TwoTerm R), P.IsPresilting ∧ P.projectiveClass = ProjectiveClass.of ⟨Y.obj, hY⟩ - ProjectiveClass.of ⟨X.obj, hX⟩

    A rigid differential on extended terms that is isomorphic to its Frobenius conjugate descends after adjoining enough scalars for the semilinear maps to satisfy the cyclic descent equation.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_presilting_class_of_finite_extension {k F R : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k] [Field F] [Finite F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (P : TwoTerm R) (p : (extendTwoTerm k F R P).source ⟶ (extendTwoTerm k F R P).target) (hp : (let __src := extendTwoTerm k F R P; { source := __src.source, target := __src.target, projective_source := ⋯, projective_target := ⋯, differential := p }).IsPresilting) :
    ∃ (Q : TwoTerm R), Q.IsPresilting ∧ Q.projectiveClass = P.projectiveClass

    The existence of a presilting differential on scalar-extended projective terms forces the original projective class to have a presilting representative.
